title: NASA Sun sheet: mean Earth distance 149.6×10^6 km, apparent diameter 1919 arcseconds at 1 AU
summary: Under Sun Observational Parameters the sheet lists mean distance 149.6 × 10^6 km and an apparent diameter of 1919 arcseconds at 1 AU.
body: Under the heading Sun Observational Parameters, the sheet lists apparent diameter from Earth at 1 A.U. as 1919 arcseconds, maximum 1952, minimum 1887, and distance from Earth mean 149.6 × 10^6 km, minimum 147.1, maximum 152.1. These are observational parameters on the sheet, not the model-center block. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.
